sections.heading: Low Attendance Due to ACDT Overlap
sections.summary: Most RPC call regulars were still in a concurrent ACDT call, resulting in minimal attendance and a shortened meeting.
sections.body:
- The call overlapped with an ongoing ACDT meeting, so very few participants joined.
- Chase Wright noted he would need to leave early to take his dog to the vet.
- The call was kept short, primarily covering the batch of PRs queued for merge.

sections.heading: PR 885: Optional RPC Endpoint
sections.summary: PR 885 is already implemented by many EL clients with no pushback; it will be merged with the rest of today's batch.
sections.body:
- Ignacio confirmed [PR 885](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/885#issuecomment-6766995271) defines an optional RPC endpoint already implemented in many execution-layer clients.
- The PR has been open for a long time with no objections raised.
- Boma confirmed it is on the agenda and part of the batch Chase plans to merge by end of day.

sections.heading: Docs, Fixes, Typos, and Dead Links (Group 1)
sections.summary: PRs 966, 968, 899, and 923 are non-controversial documentation fixes expected to merge without objection.
sections.body:
- Group 1 covers documentation fixes, typo corrections, and dead-link repairs across PRs 966, 968, 899, and 923.
- No objections anticipated; raised only for formal consensus.

sections.heading: eth_simulate Spec Cleanup (Group 2)
sections.summary: PRs 973 and 972 remove two error codes that no client returns, aligning the spec with what clients already do.
sections.body:
- [PR 973](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/973#issuecomment-6855733707) and [PR 972](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/972#issuecomment-6855734380) remove two error codes that no clients return.
- These changes make the spec match existing client behavior.
- No objections expected.

sections.heading: eth_simulateV1 Test Changes (Group 3)
sections.summary: PRs 931, 933, and 914 add test changes; Reth and Besu fail some tests, but Chase has open fix PRs for both.
sections.body:
- Group 3 covers PRs [931](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/931#issuecomment-6855736409), [933](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/933#issuecomment-6855735778), and [914](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/914#issuecomment-6770343167) — test changes rather than spec changes.
- Reth fails one test; Besu fails on both. Chase has PRs open against those clients to fix failures but needs maintainers to merge them.
- Some fix PRs are old and may need rebasing.
- Boma suggested following up with the Besu and Reth maintainers; Chase agreed.

sections.heading: eth_call, eth_simulate, and Create Access List Fork-Field Rejection (Group 4)
sections.summary: Geth, Nethermind, and Erigon pass all fork-field rejection tests; Besu and Reth failures are not considered blockers.
sections.body:
- Group 4 relates to fork-field rejection work stemming from issue 884, covering eth_call, eth_simulate, and Create Access List.
- Geth, Nethermind, and Erigon pass everything.
- Reth and Besu have not yet reached a 100% pass rate on these tests.
- Chase stated that three clients in agreement is sufficient and that Reth/Besu failures should not block merges, though fixes exist and should be pursued.

sections.heading: eth_getProof and op-tracer (Group 5)
sections.summary: PRs for eth_getProof and op-tracer were noted but not deeply reviewed; no objections raised.
sections.body:
- Group 5 covers eth_getProof and op-tracer PRs.
- Boma had not fully reviewed these yet but expected no objections.

sections.heading: Merge Timeline and Newer PRs
sections.summary: All listed PRs will be merged by end of day if no objections appear; newer controversial PRs deferred to next call.
sections.body:
- Chase posted in Discord that all agenda PRs would be merged by end of day absent objections, giving extra leeway for people still in the ACDT call.
- Several newer PRs were intentionally left off this agenda because they are more controversial and need more discussion time.
- Boma will review the newer PRs and report back; they will be placed on the agenda for the next call in two weeks.
